assumptions: Forecast of 100 units/day remains accurate over the 28-day horizon.
args.rationale: The recommendation to purchase 800 units is rejected. Ordering 800 units exceeds the available budget limit of $10,000 ($12,000 at SUP-A or $14,000 at SUP-B) and is unnecessary because the deficit is a timing issue, not a total volume issue. Usable inventory is 1,000 units and daily forecast is 100 units, leading to a 400-unit shortfall between 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-30. Confirmed order PO-501 (2,000 units) is scheduled to arrive on 2026-10-01. Expediting PO-501 by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 costs $450.00 and completely resolves all 400 units of unmet demand while staying within storage capacity (60 m³ vs 200 m³ limit) and total budget ($10,000).
important_factors: Existing open order PO-501 for 2000 units is confirmed for delivery on 2026-10-01.
Baseline projection shows stockout of 400 units between 2026-09-27 and 2026-09-30.
Expediting PO-501 by 4 days to 2026-09-27 fully eliminates the 400 units unmet demand at a fee of $450.00.
Recommending an 800-unit PO is infeasible due to breaching the $10,000 budget constraint ($12,000 at SUP-A / $14,000 at SUP-B) and creates unnecessary inventory.
